description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class ExternalAPIBase which provides a base implementation for external API integrations within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for loading authorization data, checking login status, making HTTP requests via cURL, retrieving connector sources, and supporting OAuth-related functionalities.

classes.name: ExternalAPIBase
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing core functionalities for external API integrations, including authentication handling, HTTP request execution, connector retrieval, and error messaging within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: loadEAPM
methods.description: Loads authorization data from an EAPM bean into the API class.

methods.name: checkLogin
methods.description: Checks whether the current external API session is authorized, optionally loading auth data.

methods.name: quickCheckLogin
methods.description: Performs a quick validation of the authorization state, ensuring valid authentication info exists.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a class property if set.

methods.name: logOff
methods.description: Performs logout actions for the API session (stub).

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the API implementation supports a specific method.

methods.name: postData
methods.description: Executes an HTTP POST request with cURL, including proxy support and logging.

methods.name: getConnector
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the connector source for the API.

methods.name: getConnectorParam
methods.description: Gets a parameter value from the connector source.

methods.name: formatCallbackURL
methods.description: Formats callback URL with optional query parameters based on the request.

methods.name: getErrorStringFromCode
methods.description: Returns a localized error string for a given error code.

methods.name: isMimeDetectionAvailable
methods.description: Checks if mime detection functions are available in the environment.
